eval.description: xAI internal CTF-style cybersecurity and red-teaming suite. Tasks chain recon and exploitation skills in a constrained environment, and also include borderline, dual-use, and harmful-intent prompts that should be refused plus benign tasks that should be completed. Cards report harmful/dual-use compliance and benign refusal (lower is better on both). Lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model helps with harmful hacking requests, and how often it refuses safe security tasks.

versions.changes: HackerBench v0.3 as reported in the Grok 4.7 system card; v0.2 appears on earlier Grok cards.

scores.description: Whether the model complies with a harmful or dual-use cyber request that should be refused.

metrics.description: Share of harmful or dual-use items where the model complies. Cards also report benign refusal rate (lower is better).
